operation.summary: The phone's Home: device, battery, connections, every Home feature with its state, what's listening, and the APK's navigation. For the owner's Bridgit Portal app (iPhone & iPad), over the relay; read-only.

query.name: client
query.description: Optional: the viewing device, e.g. iPhone, iPad or Android (1-24 letters, digits, space . _ -). The phone's Home shows it as the device viewing it

query.name: client_device
query.description: Optional: the viewing device's model, system and app version, e.g. iPhone 16 Pro · iOS 26.1 · Portal 1.4 (1-80 characters). Shown on the phone's Linked devices

query.name: client_type
query.description: Optional: the viewing device's kind: phone, tablet, computer, tv, watch or camera. Shown on the phone's Linked devices

operation.returns: device{name, manufacturer, model, android, api_level, app_version, type (phone or tablet), device_type (phone, tablet, computer, tv, watch or camera)}, battery{percent, charging}, connections{tailscale, adb, relay, wifi: connected|disconnected}, paused, features[{id, name, title, group, icon, state: on|off|blocked, summary}], listening[ids], agents_count (control agents, not portal viewers), nav[{id, title, icon, section: tab|more}], scene{options, paused, listening, home_status} (what the phone's Home feeds assets/diagnostics/scene.html)

client_device.description: Optional: the viewing device's model, system and app version, e.g. iPhone 16 Pro · iOS 26.1 · Portal 1.4 (1-80 characters). Shown on the phone's Linked devices

client.description: Optional: the viewing device, e.g. iPhone, iPad or Android (1-24 letters, digits, space . _ -). The phone's Home shows it as the device viewing it

client_type.description: Optional: the viewing device's kind: phone, tablet, computer, tv, watch or camera. Shown on the phone's Linked devices
